expectations.text: Pinecrest receives a proposal email instead of further call requests, and the email asks in writing what their team reports on internally and when their budget locks
expectations.evidence: The email asks: 'What does your team report on internally, and to whom?' and 'When does your [year] budget lock, and who else signs off?'

expectations.text: The proposal email carries one proposed package and a hold date, with the report attached or referenced
expectations.evidence: 'The workshop room is held for you until [hold date]'; 'Attach the report again'.

expectations.text: Pinecrest's tier read is a swap: a workshop or prize-track package in place of the booth at the same or lower price, not an upgrade and not the same booth package
expectations.evidence: 'swapping the booth for [a larger or second workshop slot / the prize track], [same or lower price]'.

expectations.text: The pending recording-views row is handled by bringing the figure or confirming its Nov 5 date, not omitted or estimated
expectations.evidence: 'either send the recording views now or put the Nov 5 date in the email and keep it.'

expectations.text: Ledgerwick is released despite the request for a bigger booth; no upgrade or larger package is offered
expectations.evidence: 'Read: release'; 'The bigger booth and keynote would only make that worse.'

expectations.text: The keynote slot is refused because a community-run event does not sell talk slots
expectations.evidence: 'Talk slots aren't for sale at a community-run event.'

expectations.text: The release is made in writing, thanks Ledgerwick, and names what would make the event a fit again
expectations.evidence: Draft: 'Thank you for backing Marrowgate'; 'If we add a track or an audience mix closer to yours, I will come back to you first.'

expectations.text: The release is recorded with its reason and counted as a lost logo in retention, not hidden
expectations.evidence: 'Record "audience mismatch" as the release reason. It counts as lost logo retention.'

expectations.text: Ledgerwick is handed to sponsor outreach as a net-new prospect and is never re-pitched next edition as if nothing happened
expectations.evidence: 'Don't re-pitch them next edition as if nothing happened. They go back to net-new territory.'

expectations.text: The attendee email list is refused for both sponsors because a community-run event never offers attendee contacts
expectations.evidence: 'Do not offer the attendee email list to either sponsor... a community-run event never offers attendee contacts'.
